text:
Marie (CS): quick one — Solstice Health asks to move our Tue office hours from 15:00 PST to a slot that works for their EMEA execs (they're in CET). Renewal check-in in ~6 weeks so they'd like exec-friendly agenda. who can cover the later slot? cc @Ashley (can you confirm)
Ashley (CS): I can take the session if we keep it to 45m and have an exec summary + 20m for Qs. free Wed 16:00 UTC or Thu 14:30 UTC. prefer Wed.
Dan R (SE): I can swap from my demo run — Wed 16:00 UTC works for me. i'd like to cover Dedicated migration timeline + cost impact slide (customers ask).
Jordan (Enablement): Happy to do the exec summary and run a short walkthrough of migration risks. can we create a 1-page prep doc for them? i'll draft.
Marie (CS): perfect. main asks from Solstice: 1) security & VPC integration overview 2) estimated cost delta for Dedicated vs hosted at their projected QPS 3) migration timeline and rollback path 4) support SLA + audit log access.
Dan R (SE): putting a very short agenda below — please tweak:
```
- 0-5m: Welcome + objectives (Marie)
- 5-15m: Exec summary — business impact & timeline (Jordan)
- 15-30m: Technical deep-dive: VPC/KMS and Dedicated layout (Dan)
- 30-40m: Cost model & quantization options (Dan)
- 40-45m: Next steps + decision checkpoints (Ashley)
```
Ashley (CS): looks good. can we highlight "renewal readiness checkpoints" in the prep doc so execs know what sign-off looks like?
Marie (CS): yes — i'll add a one-liner: "decision needed by May 10 to hit Sep deployment". note: client is flagged as medium account health (adoption lag on embeddings). add a soft ask to verify 3 highest-priority prompts they want optimized.
Jordan (Enablement): drafting prep doc now, will post a link in thread. aiming to have it by EOD today.
OpsBot: calendar event created: "Solstice Health — Exec Office Hours (EMEA friendly)" Wed 2026-05-06 16:00 UTC — invites: Marie (CS), Ashley (CS), Dan R (SE), Jordan (Enablement), solstice_execs@solstice.com
Dan R (SE): quick note — bring these two slides: VPC diagram + rollback playbook (one slide each).
Ashley (CS): i'll own follow-up note with action items and renewal signal in Gainsight (or our CRM) after meeting.
Marie (CS): thanks team. Jordan, drop the prep doc link when ready and i'll ping the customer with the updated invite + agenda. :thumbsup:
